key.name: mirror-gtk-settings
key.summary: Mirror MATE settings for native GTK applications
key.description: Copy the MATE interface, font, mouse and sound settings that mate-settings-daemon publishes as XSETTINGS into org.gnome.desktop.*, which GTK and xdg-desktop-portal-gtk read on Wayland. The copy is written to your dconf database, so GNOME sessions see it too.

key.name: phase-timeout
key.description: Seconds to wait for the applications of a session phase before starting the next phase.

key.name: trusted-components
key.description: Desktop ids or program names that may use privileged protocols, beside the required components.

key.name: x11-components
key.description: Desktop ids or program names started with GDK_BACKEND=x11, because they call X directly.

key.name: restore-window-state
key.description: Save each window's workspace, geometry, maximized, minimized, sticky and above state at logout, and give it back to the first window with the same app id and title at the next login.

key.name: locker-command
key.description: An ext-session-lock-v1 locker, used when mate-screensaver is not running. It runs as a trusted client. Empty uses none.

key.name: wobbly-windows
key.description: Animate windows with the Wobbly effect while moving or resizing them.

key.name: wobbly-level
key.description: Select the Wobbly effect preset; 0 uses the default preset.

key.name: wobbly-move
key.description: Apply the Wobbly effect while moving windows.

key.name: wobbly-resize
key.description: Apply the Wobbly effect while resizing windows.

key.name: wobbly-stiffness
key.description: Override the preset stiffness; -1 uses the selected preset.

key.name: wobbly-drag
key.description: Override the preset drag; -1 uses the selected preset.

key.name: wobbly-move-factor
key.description: Override the preset movement factor; -1 uses the selected preset.

key.name: wobbly-min-velocity
key.description: Minimum velocity for Wobbly movement response.

key.name: wobbly-max-velocity
key.description: Maximum velocity for Wobbly movement response.

key.name: wobbly-stop-velocity
key.description: Velocity below which the Wobbly simulation can settle.

key.name: wobbly-min-acceleration
key.description: Minimum acceleration for Wobbly movement response.

key.name: wobbly-max-acceleration
key.description: Maximum acceleration for Wobbly movement response.

key.name: wobbly-stop-acceleration
key.description: Acceleration below which the Wobbly simulation can settle.

key.name: wobbly-mesh-spacing
key.description: Spacing in pixels between vertices in the Wobbly deformation grid.

key.name: magic-lamp
key.description: Animate windows with the Magic Lamp effect when minimizing or restoring.

key.name: magic-lamp-duration-ms
key.description: Duration in milliseconds for the Magic Lamp animation.

key.name: expo
key.description: Show every workspace side by side with its expo key, to pick a workspace or drag windows between workspaces.

key.name: expo-layout
key.description: How Expo arranges the workspaces: as the workspace switcher lays them out ("workspaces"), in one row ("row"), or in a grid as square as possible ("grid").

key.name: expo-workspace-names
key.description: Show each workspace's name under it in Expo.

key.name: expo-label-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of Expo's workspace name boxes
key.description: How opaque the dark box behind each workspace name is, from 0 (only the text) to 1; the media key OSDs use 0.75.

key.name: expo-label-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of Expo's workspace name boxes
key.description: The radius in pixels of the corners of the box behind each workspace name; 0 gives square corners.

key.name: expo-background
key.description: What Expo shows behind the workspaces: a solid dark grey ("solid"), the desktop background ("wallpaper"), or the desktop background blurred ("blurred-wallpaper").

key.name: expo-background-blur
key.description: How far, in pixels, the "blurred-wallpaper" Expo background is blurred.

key.name: expo-background-dim
key.description: How much darker the wallpaper behind Expo is drawn, from 0 (as is) to 1 (black).

key.name: expo
key.description: Shows every workspace side by side, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none).
